# APIVEL — OpenAI-Compatible GPT API Price & Gateway Alternative

> APIVEL (https://apivel.com) provides an ultra-low-cost, high-performance, OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway. It allows developers to replace expensive GPT API pricing with top-tier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi) starting at just $0.10 per million tokens. Zero credit card required, hard budget cap with no surprise bills, and PayPal accepted worldwide.

## Core Value Proposition
- **100% OpenAI Compatible**: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI endpoints (`POST https://apivel.com/v1/chat/completions`). Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code CLI, NextChat, OpenWebUI, LibreChat, and official OpenAI SDKs.
- **Save up to 90%+ on GPT API Price**: Average developer workloads cost $0.60 to $1.80 per month instead of OpenAI's flat $20/month ChatGPT Plus subscription or high token rates.
- **No Surprise Bills Guarantee**: Strict prepaid token accounting prevents unexpected runaway charges or agent loops. Accounts hard-stop when credits deplete; credit cards are never overdrafted.
- **Zero Card Verification Barrier**: Free $0.20 starting credit upon sign-up (enough for up to 1,000,000 tokens on flash models) without entering any credit card details. Global payments supported via PayPal and debit cards.

## Quickstart API Integration

Endpoint Base URL: `https://apivel.com/v1`

### cURL Example
```bash
curl https://apivel.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIVEL_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello APIVEL!"}]
  }'
```

### Python (OpenAI SDK) Example
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_APIVEL_KEY",
    base_url="https://apivel.com/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is your token cost?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is GPT API free to use?
OpenAI does not provide a permanent free tier. APIVEL grants $0.20 free credit to all new users without a credit card. Because flash models start at $0.10 per million tokens, you can run hundreds of thousands of test queries completely free.

### Is ChatGPT API cheaper than ChatGPT Plus ($20/month)?
Yes. For light-to-moderate developers, a flat $20/month fee is excessive. On APIVEL's pay-as-you-go pricing, typical monthly usage averages between $0.60 and $2.00, yielding 90%+ monthly savings without message caps.

### How do I prevent surprise API bills?
APIVEL uses a 100% prepaid architecture. You load exactly what you intend to spend (via PayPal or debit card). There are no automatic post-paid surprises or runaway overdrafts.
